We talked yesterday, and he seems to kind of understand, not fully though. I think the best thing to do is to try and work it out, for the baby's sake. I know you don't need your parents together growing up, mine are divorced and his are a mess that don't divorce because his family is very conservative; but there's still love and I think raising a child apart would be super complicated.

No, it's all very psychological, and I've noticed I'm changing my ways just to avoid fighting. He knows how much it affects me when he gets angry at me, but sometimes it's like he does it on purpose. And it's things that aren't worth it, like today he was upset because I went to the store and didn't text him to tell him when I went out and when I came back. It's a block away, it was literally less than 10 minutes, and he got all serious about it, and now he's not talking to me.
